column3: Most of you said: follow the stranger.
You jump down onto the tracks. Behind you, the conductor is still shouting.
He walks fast. He doesn't even need the light.
A steel door in the tunnel wall. He types the code without looking.
Halfway down, he stops at an old wall phone. One call. He won't say who.
Stop. Card.
Inside the case: radiation pills, and a keycard. The face on the card isn't his.
This is Doctor Vale's card. Where is Doctor Vale?
My brother didn't make it. He gave me his place.
And who is this?
One civilian per card. Not two.
Family is on the list. Say you're family. We both get in.
You don't know Doctor Vale. You don't even know Eli.
Do you lie for him, or tell the soldier the truth?
Follow for part three.
Get back here! Both of you!
Something scurries over your shoes. He doesn't even flinch.
Your phone says four minutes left.
He says it like he's practiced it.
And when the countdown hits zero, this door seals. For twenty-four hours.
